## GrandChase Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.kog.grandchaseglobal`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### ⚔️ Tab 1 — Damage (`Player Offense & Survival`)
- **God Mode** — Block all incoming damage to player & allies
- **One-Hit Kill** — Deal 999M damage to all enemies
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 100x`)** — Scale player & ally damage dealt across all attack types
- **Enemy Damage Multiplier (`0.0x – 2.0x`)** — Scale enemy damage (`0.0x` = harmless)
- *Upstream `EMEGFKIEADN` stack-verifier safe hooks so heals stay intact and encrypted `NJKMPAKKHNH` double checksums match*

### ❤️ Tab 2 — Def & HP (`Player Stats & Enemy Weakening`)
- **Player Max HP (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiply player & ally Max HP (syncs spawn HP automatically)
- **Player ATK (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiply player & ally Physical & Magical ATK live
- **Player DEF (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiply player & ally DEF + damage reduction
- **Enemy Max HP (`0.1x – 1.0x`)** — Scale enemy Max HP & clamp current HP down
- **Enemy DEF (`0.0x – 1.0x`)** — Scale enemy DEF (`0.0x` = ignore enemy DEF completely)

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

- Added GrandChase Global (`com.kog.grandchaseglobal`) support for v2.9.4
- Added 6 IL2CPP Auto-Offset resolvers + 1-User Device Token Lock & custom floating icon
